basis: Blocked-preflight observations only: 8 samples, C0 median 179.499229 s, max 317.913357 s, 4/8 exceed the previous 180 s cap. Set a provisional 600 s C0 cap (282.086643 s headroom over this sample maximum); this is a planning margin, not a latency guarantee. Add exactly 420 s to the total task cap (2700 -> 3120), preserving 2520 s after a fully consumed C0. Native build/correctness/collection and successful full-memory costs remain uncalibrated; retain their existing provisional limits and do not promise five rounds. Original-oracle integration measured 177.864392 seconds for independent replay of 20 exp cases. A comparison may require both baseline and candidate outputs; the old 120-second finalize cap is insufficient. Set finalize to 600 seconds within the unchanged 3120-second continuous task deadline; C0=600, full_correctness=300, recorder=600 and reuse limits remain unchanged.
deadline_rule: Receipt of frozen seed starts one continuous monotonic deadline; no extension or restart.
retest_policy: At most one prespecified repeat per implementation/case for CV>0.05 or absolute HAP distance<=0.01 or speedup distance<=0.005 from gate; retain both, never select favorable sample; otherwise no retry.
reuse_basis: Conservative maximum limits, not calibrated constants; no reuse allowed without device/frequency/state evidence. No captures exist at intake.
effective_scope: New APROF 1.1.0 Vector acceptance campaigns, both machine-a and machine-b; never changes a dispatched task or historical record.
activation_status: Freeze this policy into each new archive before first seed delivery; no run is dispatched by editing this file.

observations.sample_scope: 8 completed C0-blocked tasks and their partial-memory receipts; no successful native C0/R0/candidate/collection measurements
observations.recorder_cost_limitations: Receipt-cutoff lower bounds; exact final-response tails and full-performance-memory costs are unavailable.
observations.dispatch_clock_caveat: These are wall-timestamp request-to-session intervals, not authoritative monotonic queue durations; never subtract them from recorded continuous task costs.

dispatch_rule: Check session capacity before delivering seed and starting task launch. Record pre-delivery batch waiting separately. Once seed is delivered, all model/tool/dispatch waiting remains inside the continuous task clock; a rejected dispatch never resets or extends it.
adoption_requirements: Use a new run and distinct output path; freeze this policy before any seed is delivered. Do not rewrite the completed campaign or its input lock.
Bind stage_timeout_seconds.C0_capability=600 consistently in coordinator instructions, per-stage timeout/remaining-budget checks and C0 cost/overrun reporting.
Bind task_budget_seconds=3120 into every new batch task budget_seconds and derive launch/context/child deadlines from the same original monotonic start. No continuation reset.
Read memory_separate_budget_seconds=600 for recorder requests and budget checks; it includes validation, with validation cost itemized without double-counting.
Retain five-candidate maximum, 1200 s collection/R1 reserves, original cases/oracle/protocol and reuse policy; increasing task budget does not lengthen measurement validity windows.

Old archived helper scripts contain budget literals; they are not updated in place or automatically activated by this policy. Any future execution copy must consume the frozen policy values as listed in the batch.md and the selected coordinator workflow.
Stop promptly on a verified hard blocker. More budget does not repair the frozen BF16/oracle interface; a runnable controlled package/input lock is required for formal measurement.

For original_python_v1, use stage_timeout_seconds.finalize=600, bounded by the unchanged original task deadline. Do not inherit the old 120 s finalize literal; unchanged bytes may reuse only an in-process result created by actual oracle execution.
